title: Checkout error troubleshooting
content: Check the checkout service status and recent error rate. If checkout is degraded, inspect timeout and upstream payment errors before escalating. Record evidence before creating an incident.

title: Alert triage and escalation
content: Confirm alert scope, duration, and customer impact. Suppress duplicate notifications, assign an owner, and escalate only when the alert remains actionable after initial checks.

title: Incident severity classification
content: Use P1 for broad active customer impact, P2 for significant degradation, P3 for limited impact, and P4 for minor issues. Document the evidence used to select a severity.

title: Database connection saturation
content: Check connection pool utilization, slow queries, and waiting requests. Reduce nonessential load and avoid restarting a healthy database without confirming the source of saturation.

title: Payment timeout runbook
content: Inspect payment gateway latency and checkout timeout errors. Verify whether retries are safe, avoid duplicate charges, and escalate persistent gateway failures with representative timestamps.

title: Deployment rollback procedure
content: Confirm the affected release and compare current errors with the previous deployment window. Roll back through the approved deployment process and verify service health afterward.

title: Service maintenance verification
content: Review the maintenance window and expected customer impact. Do not treat an announced maintenance state as an outage, but investigate errors that continue after the window ends.
